acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-smtp passes; allow_non_loopback=true without bearer_token on non-loopback fails the guard; clippy clean
description:
## What
In crates/smtp/src/sieve_admin.rs, fix the gap where allow_non_loopback=true allows binding to a non-loopback address without a bearer_token. The token must be required whenever the address is non-loopback, regardless of allow_non_loopback.

## Algorithm
1. Read crates/smtp/src/sieve_admin.rs lines 100-130.
2. Find the existing guard (around line 112):
     if !is_loopback_addr(bind) && !config.sieve_admin.allow_non_loopback && !has_token { exit(1) }
3. Change to: require token whenever non-loopback, regardless of allow_non_loopback:
     if !is_loopback_addr(bind) && !has_token {
         eprintln!(
             'error: sieve admin API is bound to non-loopback address ({}) without a bearer_token. \
Any host on the network can read and overwrite user mail filter scripts. \
Set sieve_admin.bearer_token to a secret value, or change sieve_admin.bind to 127.0.0.1.',
             bind
         );
         std::process::exit(1);
     }
4. The allow_non_loopback field now ONLY controls whether a non-loopback bind with a valid token emits a warning or not (it no longer bypasses the token requirement). Update the subsequent warning logic accordingly.
5. Update docs/comments on allow_non_loopback in config.rs to reflect narrowed semantics.
6. cargo fmt; cargo clippy clean; cargo test --workspace clean.

## Defensive programming rules
- The error message must be actionable.
- allow_non_loopback must NOT be deleted (it still serves a purpose: suppresses the informational warning for ops who know what they are doing with a properly-tokenized setup).
- No new function needed; inline change only.

## Tests
Add to sieve_admin test module:
- test_non_loopback_no_token_allow_flag_is_fatal: allow_non_loopback=true, no bearer_token, non-loopback addr → condition (non_loopback && no_token) = true. Oracle: the patched guard condition.
- test_non_loopback_with_token_ok: allow_non_loopback=true, bearer_token set, non-loopback → condition = false. Oracle: token present bypasses token guard.
title: smtp: tighten sieve_admin allow_non_loopback to require bearer_token
